notes:
Summary: Mid-market product company building semantic product discovery + recommendations. Primary objective is to replace an expensive vector-search prototype with a production-grade pipeline that scales nightly batch jobs and supports interactive site search. POC path: start on Hosted API to validate embeddings quality and search relevance, then move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and nightly batch indexing if numbers hold.

Technical requirements / priorities (raw):
- Workload: nightly batch indexing (~100k - 300k new vectors/day), realtime site search queries during day (target 150-250 qps at peak), similarity reranking for recommendations (~50 qps).
- Latency SLO: 50-150ms 95p for single-vector query; under 250ms for rerank (95p).
- Embedding dim: currently using 1536-d vectors from prototype models; evaluating Redwood model catalog (open encoder) vs existing embedding provider for quality + cost tradeoffs.
- Vector DB: primary POC to use Pinecone (easy), but must be able to switch to Milvus/Weaviate on Dedicated or private infra. Connector stability + bulk upsert performance are key.
- Batch jobs: large nightly upserts (10k-300k vectors) — need fast bulk write paths, backpressure controls, and KV cache persistence to avoid cold-start penalties on morning traffic.
- Throughput needs: embeddings generation pipeline should sustain ~200 qps when parallelized; search layer needs consistent tail latency.
- Cost sensitivity: product finance wants committed pricing for Dedicated if it reduces unit costs by ~25% vs Hosted. PO: mid-6 figure ARR if adoption expands across product modules.

Security / compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, audit logs for vector accesses, KMS for keys, EU data residency for subset of customer data. Legal will require DPA and a data mapping before procurement.

Quotes / call snippets: "If we can make nightly indexing predictable and drop tail latency, we can replace the current setup. Need a cost model that doesn't blow up on growth." — Head of Product.

Integration notes: developers wired Redwood embeddings endpoint into ETL; initial token-costs flagged as higher than expected during small-scale runs. SE recommended batching + prefix caching and offered Redwood Optimize suggestions. Team wants a dedicated demo to validate GPU-backed throughput and storage-backed KV cache behavior.

POC success metrics (customer defined): relevance delta >= +8% on NDCG vs baseline, average search 95p latency <150ms, nightly indexing complete within 4 hours for 200k vectors, unit cost per vector + query within financial guardrails.
